particle_loading: Deterministic paired quiet Cartesian lattice clipped to a sphere
primary_field_probe_rule: At least 0.5R from the PEC and the initial plasma-cloud boundary; selected before JefiPIC results or fine96-reference results. All five probes are retained for audit.
driving_definition: Prescribed NON-electromagnetic body force F_s=q_s*E0*sin(pi*t/Tpulse)^2*zhat for 0<t<Tpulse; zero otherwise. It is not part of the Maxwell fields and is not applied to the conductor.
initial_state: E=B=rho=J=P=K=0; coincident, resting electron/ion pairs; zero prehistory.
conductor: Isolated initially neutral PEC sphere, no prescribed potential, no collection events permitted.
field_boundary: Outgoing free-space; WarpX finite PML approximates it; check box extension.
numerical_policy: Different discretizations and timesteps are permitted; no fitted gain, phase, time shift, or frequency.
